campaign.title: PRISM Cross-Paradigm Benchmark & Synthesis Campaign
campaign.description: Comprehensive benchmark orchestrating all PRISM learning paradigms, architectures, robustness evaluations, uncertainty calibrations, and spatial/temporal transfer probes.

research_questions.natural_language_question: How does self-supervised pretraining (SimCLR vs Reconstruction) compare to Supervised pretraining on downstream linear probe accuracy across data budgets?
limitations: Linear probe only; non-linear fine-tuning may show different dynamics.

research_questions.natural_language_question: What is the comparative inductive bias and spatial retention of CNNs, ResNets, and ViTs under clean accuracy, corruption robustness, and dense spatial transfer?
limitations: Evaluated at standardized scale without ImageNet-22k pretraining.

research_questions.natural_language_question: Does higher test accuracy correlate with improved uncertainty calibration (ECE) and out-of-distribution detection AUROC across architectures and objectives?
limitations: Calibration evaluated via standard temperature scaling.

warnings: EVIDENCE_GAP_DETECTED: 5571 planned experimental factor combinations have not yet been observed.

findings.statement: Under controlled evaluation of pretraining_objective, 'supervised' achieved the most favorable Linear Probe Accuracy (0.998) compared to 'simclr' (0.968), with a delta of 0.031.
caveats: Grounding restricted to evaluated dataset: cifar10.
Standard transferability and linear separability metric.

findings.statement: Under controlled evaluation of pretraining_objective, 'simclr' achieved the most favorable Transfer Learning Gain (0.303) compared to 'vision_language' (0.290), with a delta of 0.012.
caveats: Grounding restricted to evaluated dataset: cifar10.
Positive gain indicates beneficial pretraining transfer.

findings.statement: Under controlled evaluation of architecture, 'vit' achieved the most favorable In-Distribution Accuracy (0.963) compared to 'resnet' (0.956), with a delta of 0.007.
caveats: Grounding restricted to evaluated dataset: cifar10.

findings.statement: Under controlled evaluation of architecture, 'vit' achieved the most favorable Corruption Accuracy Drop (0.265) compared to 'resnet' (0.268), with a delta of 0.003.
caveats: Grounding restricted to evaluated dataset: cifar10.

findings.statement: Under controlled evaluation of architecture, 'resnet' achieved the most favorable Spatial Detection Mean IoU (0.724) compared to 'vit' (0.709), with a delta of 0.015.
caveats: Grounding restricted to evaluated dataset: cifar10.
Detection mean IoU from lightweight synthetic spatial probe; not COCO mAP.

findings.statement: Under controlled evaluation of architecture, 'resnet' achieved the most favorable Spatial Segmentation mIoU (0.696) compared to 'vit' (0.682), with a delta of 0.014.
caveats: Grounding restricted to evaluated dataset: cifar10.
Segmentation mean IoU on 2D synthetic spatial shapes.

findings.statement: Under controlled evaluation of architecture, 'vit' achieved the most favorable In-Distribution Accuracy (0.963) compared to 'resnet' (0.956), with a delta of 0.007.
caveats: Grounding restricted to evaluated dataset: cifar10.

findings.statement: Under controlled evaluation of architecture, 'cnn' achieved the most favorable Expected Calibration Error (ECE) (0.189) compared to 'resnet' (0.203), with a delta of 0.014.
caveats: Grounding restricted to evaluated dataset: cifar10.
Expected Calibration Error from equal-width reliability bins.

findings.statement: Under controlled evaluation of architecture, 'vit' achieved the most favorable OOD Detection AUROC (0.989) compared to 'resnet' (0.981), with a delta of 0.008.
caveats: Grounding restricted to evaluated dataset: cifar10.
OOD AUROC from controlled synthetic OOD suite.

report_summary.title: PRISM Research Synthesis: PRISM Cross-Paradigm Benchmark & Synthesis Campaign
report_summary.executive_summary: This benchmark report synthesizes experimental evidence from campaign 'prism_canonical_phase24'. Total registered observations: 810, covering 45 completed factor combinations (0.8% campaign completion). Key findings highlight distinct representation profiles across architectures and pretraining objectives without collapsing tradeoffs into a single aggregate metric.
report_summary.methodology_summary: Evaluations enforce strict pairwise factor control. Only designated independent variables are varied while keeping architecture backbones, dataset splits, optimization parameters, and random seeds strictly aligned.
